method: Exact pinned original extractor on current public Rspack issue comments, with separate versus concatenated comment comparisons.
limits: The original source extractor joined issue-comment bodies with newline characters.
GitHub comment content and order reflect current public API state.
This audit isolates issue comments. Other original sources remain outside this boundary test.
Separator insertion is a controlled diagnostic input transformation.

boundary_test_definition.joined: Append GitHub issue-thread comment bodies with newline delimiter, preserving API order.
boundary_test_definition.separated: Execute original D6 extractor separately on each GitHub issue-thread comment.
boundary_test_definition.padded: Insert 32 inert marker tokens between successive issue-thread comments before running the original D6 extractor.

original_validation_scope: This reproduces the 97 published D6 labels from current public GitHub issue-thread comments. The archived PR evidence snapshot and independent source fields were outside this test.
